description_en: Provides a unified entry point to invoke data products
description_zh: 数据产品统一调用入口
kebab_example: aliyun internetbankopen invoke-data-product --client-token a1b2c3d4-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d --product-code cloudsec.demo.v1 --service-parameters '{"mobileMd5":"25f9e794323b453885f5181f1b624d0b","certNoSha256":"a665a45920422f9d417e4867efdc4fb8a04a1f3fff1fa07e998e86f7f7a27ae3"}' --api-version 2024-06-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeDataProduct

parameters.help_en: The customer transaction serial number used for idempotence. This parameter is required for business purposes. If it is missing, MissingParameter.ClientToken is returned. Only 1 to 64 ASCII letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), or hyphens (-) are allowed. It is case-sensitive and leading and trailing spaces are not trimmed. If the format is invalid, InvalidParameter.ClientToken is returned. The ClientToken is globally unique under the same Alibaba Cloud account and is not product-specific. When you retry with the same parameters, the result of the first call and the original CallId are returned, and the data service provider is not called again. If the first request is still being processed, RequestInProgress (HTTP 409) is returned. Retry with the original parameters later. If the same ClientToken is used with a different ProductCode or ServiceParameters, IdempotentParameterMismatch is returned. Use a new serial number. If the result is not obtained due to a network interruption, retry with the original ClientToken and do not change the serial number
parameters.help_zh: 客户交易流水号，用于幂等。业务上必填，缺失时返回 MissingParameter.ClientToken；只允许 1～64 位 ASCII 字母、数字、点（.）、下划线（_）或短横线（-），区分大小写且不去除首尾空格，格式不符时返回 InvalidParameter.ClientToken。同一云账号（主账号）下 ClientToken 全局唯一，不区分商品：以相同参数重试时，返回首次调用的结果和原 CallId，不会再次调用数据服务方；首次请求仍在处理时返回 RequestInProgress（HTTP 409），请稍后按原参数重试；同一 ClientToken 携带不同的 ProductCode 或 ServiceParameters 时返回 IdempotentParameterMismatch，请换用新的流水号。网络中断未拿到结果时，请使用原 ClientToken 重试，不要更换流水号
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The commodity code of the data product, used to identify the data product invoked in this call. The gateway uses this code to complete product authorization and route the request to the corresponding data service provider. This parameter is required for business purposes. If it is missing, MissingParameter.ProductCode is returned. If the code is not registered or is deactivated, InvalidParameter.ProductCode is returned. If the current account has not activated the product, Forbidden.ProductNotAuthorized is returned
parameters.help_zh: 数据产品商品编码，用于标识本次调用的数据产品；网关据此完成商品授权并路由到对应数据服务方。业务上必填，缺失时返回 MissingParameter.ProductCode；编码未登记或已停用时返回 InvalidParameter.ProductCode；当前账号未开通该商品时返回 Forbidden.ProductNotAuthorized
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The business element package, which must be a JSON object serialized as a string. It carries the business parameters required for this data product invocation. This parameter is required for business purposes. If it is missing, MissingParameter.ServiceParameters is returned. For sensitive information such as mobile phone numbers and ID card numbers, only digests are passed, and plaintext is not allowed. If plaintext fields such as mobile or certNo are passed, InvalidParameter.ServiceParameters is returned. Fields ending with Sha256 must be 64-character hexadecimal strings, and fields ending with Md5 must be 32-character hexadecimal strings. Uppercase letters are automatically converted to lowercase. The specific required elements are determined by the product corresponding to the ProductCode. For example, some products require at least one of mobileSha256 and mobileMd5. If required elements are missing, the JSON is invalid, or the digest format is incorrect, InvalidParameter.ServiceParameters is returned
parameters.help_zh: 业务要素整包，必须是序列化为字符串的 JSON 对象，承载本次数据产品调用所需的业务参数。业务上必填，缺失时返回 MissingParameter.ServiceParameters。手机号、证件号等敏感信息只传摘要，不传明文：传入 mobile、certNo 明文字段时返回 InvalidParameter.ServiceParameters。以 Sha256 结尾的字段须为 64 位十六进制字符串，以 Md5 结尾的字段须为 32 位十六进制字符串，大写会自动转为小写。具体必填要素由 ProductCode 对应的商品决定（例如部分商品要求 mobileSha256 与 mobileMd5 至少传一个），缺少必填要素、JSON 不合法或摘要格式错误时均返回 InvalidParameter.ServiceParameters
parameters.name: service_parameters

data.description_en: The business result of this invocation, which is a JSON object. If the invocation is successful, it contains: contractVersion (the contract version, fixed as PRODUCT_CALL_V1), callId (the invocation ID, in the format of call- followed by a UUID, used for querying AI reports and troubleshooting), dataStatus (FOUND indicates that data is found, and NOT_FOUND indicates that no data is found), extend (the business result returned by the data service provider, passed through as is. The specific structure depends on the data product and may not be returned if no data is found), and reportMode (the product report mode: NONE indicates no report, PER_CALL indicates that a report is generated for each invocation, and WEEKLY indicates that a report is generated on a weekly basis). If the invocation fails or the first request is still being processed, contractVersion and callId are still returned if an invocation ID has been assigned, to facilitate retrying with the original ClientToken
data.description_zh: 本次调用的业务结果，为 JSON 对象。调用成功时包含：contractVersion（契约版本，固定为 PRODUCT_CALL_V1）、callId（本次调用编号，格式为 call- 加 UUID，用于查询 AI 报告和问题排查）、dataStatus（FOUND 表示查得，NOT_FOUND 表示查无）、extend（数据服务方返回的业务结果，原样透传，具体结构随数据产品而定，查无时可能不返回）和 reportMode（商品报告模式：NONE 表示无报告，PER_CALL 表示每次调用生成报告，WEEKLY 表示按自然周生成报告）。调用失败或首次请求仍在处理时，若已分配调用编号，仍会返回 contractVersion 和 callId，便于使用原 ClientToken 重试

requestId.description_en: The unique identity of this request, generated by the gateway (obtained from x-acs-req-uuid). It is used for troubleshooting and Tracing Analysis
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，由网关生成（取自 x-acs-req-uuid），用于问题排查与链路追踪
